detail: Q3 1920, district Hitchin, Hertfordshire, vol 3A p2077 — CAROLINE CASTLE married JAMES JAMES
CAROLINE JAMES, born 28 FEBRUARY 1863, female, WIDOWED, Unpaid Domestic Duties
38 Norton Road, Baldock, Baldock U.D., Hertfordshire — RG101/1598B/017/25, schedule 134
1957, registered HITCHIN, Hertfordshire, birth year given as 1862

record: # SHE WAS CAROLINE JAMES FROM 1920, WHICH IS WHY SHE COULD NOT BE FOLLOWED.
# George William Castle died in 1916. She remarried four years later and outlived that
# husband too - the 1939 Register has her widowed again at 76. Every tree carrying her
# as "Caroline Wallis 1862-1957" is looking for a death that was registered under JAMES.
# AND THE DATE OF BIRTH IS NOW EXACT: 28 FEBRUARY 1863, not 1862.
